## Wave 2 Summary

Wave 2 computes the **two geometric invariants the S96 off-Jensen Chern campaign could not see**, on the SAME 2-parameter U(2)-invariant volume-preserving TT deformation surface that `S96-GEOM-OFFJENSEN-CHERN` (PASS-TRIVIAL, `C_FHS=9.78e-15`) closed the *Chern* corridor on. The geometric picture is fixed and unchanged from S96: the substrate's lowest Dirac band is a **2-fold J/PH-degenerate real (BDI) doublet** in every Peter-Weyl sector (`band_deg=2` in `s96_geom_offjensen_chern.npz`). Reality (Kosmann `K_a` anti-Hermitian ⟹ real eigenstates, S25/W5 PROVEN, `Ω=0` at 1.12e-16) kills the **Abelian Berry curvature and the arg-det Wilczek-Zee link identically** — that is what S96 measured. But reality does NOT kill the two invariants that live on a *real* two-band bundle:

- **Item 1 (S104-EULER-CLASS-J-DOUBLET)** — the **Euler class** `e₂=(1/2π)∮ Pf(F^Euler)` (Pfaffian of the real antisymmetric non-Abelian curvature of the real frame). For a class-`I_ST²=+1` two-real-band system (Kwon-Yang, arXiv 2311.11577) this is the Z-valued invariant that survives when Chern≡0. `Pf` can be nonzero where `det`/`arg det` (the Chern/U(1) part) is exactly zero. NEVER computed on the substrate. Decisive either way.
- **Item 2 (S104-PAULI-G9-SUBCURVATURE)** — the **γ9-graded spin-resolved sub-curvature** `Ω^±=dA^±` on the γ9=±1 (Cl(8) chirality) eigenspaces of the doublet (Wei Pauli-QGT, arXiv 2409.19551). Tests whether the BDI `Ω=0` null *strengthens* to spin-resolved or *cracks* at a γ9-graded component. Bundled with item 1 — same eigenvector path. Feasibility-gated on the γ9 grading machinery being script-nameable at plan-freeze (it is: `dirac_spectrum.build_chirality`).

**Carry-forward source**: register-sourced gem-triage candidates (`--extra` 1c-REGISTERS.CONSUME), NOT WP carry-forwards. Both items reuse the S96 eigenvector-construction machinery; the delta is swapping `arg det` → Pfaffian (item 1) and adding the γ9 projection (item 2).

**Geometry-first framing (this wave's spine)**: map the geometry of the eigenvalue bundle over the modulus surface FIRST, then compute. The bundle is a real `O(2)`/BDI two-band bundle (not a complex `U(1)` line bundle) — so its characteristic class is the **Euler class** (Pfaffian of the `so(2)`-valued curvature), not the first Chern class (trace of the `u(1)`-valued curvature). S96 computed the wrong characteristic class for a real bundle. Wave 2 computes the right one.

# (7) substitution_chain
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim A: "For the lowest 2-fold real (BDI) doublet, Pf^2 = det, so the Euler class
              squared equals the (second) Chern class; with Chern=0 (S96), Euler=0 IFF
              the real-frame curvature also vanishes -- a SEPARATE condition the gate tests."
      Def 1: F^Euler = the so(2)-valued (real antisymmetric 2x2) curvature of the real
             rank-2 frame O(tau,mu); a 2x2 antisymmetric matrix has the form
             [[0, f],[-f, 0]] with a single real entry f.
      Def 2: Pf([[0,f],[-f,0]]) = f          (Pfaffian of the 2x2 antisymmetric block).
      Def 3: det([[0,f],[-f,0]]) = f^2 = (Pf)^2.   (general identity Pf(A)^2 = det(A) for
             antisymmetric A; smoke-tested at 1.78e-14 residual on a random 4x4.)
      Def 4: e2 = (1/2pi) oint Pf(F^Euler) ;  the U(1)/complex first-Chern of the SAME
             bundle is c1 = (1/2pi) oint tr(i F^{u(1)}) -- a DIFFERENT trace of a DIFFERENT
             (the arg-det) component. S96 measured c1-type (arg det link) = 0.
      Substitute: Pf is LINEAR in f (sign-sensitive), whereas det = f^2 is QUADRATIC
             (sign-blind). The arg-det Wilczek-Zee link S96 used reads det(M)/|det(M)|
             of the COMPLEX overlap M -- its phase is the U(1) (Chern) part; it is
             IDENTICALLY 1 (phase 0) when the eigenstates are real (M real => det real =>
             arg = 0 or pi, and the |lambda|-min reality forces the trivial branch).
      Simplify: a real frame can still ROTATE around the loop (an element of SO(2) with
             nonzero rotation angle) WITHOUT any complex phase. That rotation is exactly
             the Euler holonomy; its generator is the off-diagonal f. arg det sees |det|=1
             (no U(1) winding) but Pf sees the SO(2) rotation angle.
      Canonical form: e2 = (1/2pi) oint f(tau,mu) (d tau ^ d mu integrated as the SO(2)
             holonomy angle / 2pi summed over plaquettes).
      Direction: e2 is a SIGNED integer (orientation-dependent); PASS-TRIVIAL is e2=0
             (no net real-frame rotation), PASS-NONTRIVIAL is e2=n!=0 (n net 2pi rotations
             of the real frame around the closed surface).
      Conclusion: "Chern=0 does NOT imply Euler=0. The S96 PASS-TRIVIAL (arg det=0) is
             SILENT on the Pfaffian of the real frame. e2 is genuinely uncomputed and the
             gate decides it." 

    Claim B: "What Euler != 0 would force."
      Def 5: a nonzero Euler class of the lowest-band real bundle = an obstruction to a
             global real non-rotating frame = a genuine substrate topological invariant
             surviving the reality (BDI) that kills Berry curvature.
      Substitute: by the Kwon-Yang quantum-volume <-> Euler bound (paper 01), a nonzero
             e2 lower-bounds the integrated quantum volume on the enclosed region, tying
             the §VII.W quantum-metric reservoir (g~982.5, the metric-without-curvature
             content) to a NONZERO topological charge.
      Direction: e2 != 0 INVERTS the "metric-without-curvature" reading (the g reservoir
             would then be topologically active, not inert).
      Conclusion: "PASS-NONTRIVIAL re-opens the topology-survives-dissolution spine S96
             closed only for Chern, and forces a new §VII candidate; PASS-TRIVIAL closes
             the LAST geometric-invariant escape route, making g~982.5 the SOLE
             topologically-active object (strongest metric-without-curvature wall)."

    gamma9 machinery IS nameable: dirac_spectrum.build_chirality(gammas) returns the
    (16,16) Hermitian involution gamma9 = gamma_1...gamma_8 (gamma9^2=I, {gamma9,gamma_a}=0,
    gamma9^dag=gamma9; verified at lines 372-391 + self-test 1968-1976). The grading on
    H_K acts as gamma9 (x) I_dim on the (p,q)-sector Dirac space (the spin factor is the
    16-dim Cl(8) module; gamma9 grades it). Procedure:
      (1) at each NODE build the lowest doublet block (dim,2) + the full eigvecs via
          lowest_band_multiplet(...,deg=2) [reused from S96];
      (2) form the graded chirality operator G9 = gamma9 (x) I_dim on the sector space
          (kron with identity on the irrep factor; for (0,0) singlet G9 = gamma9 directly);
      (3) project the doublet onto the G9=+1 and G9=-1 eigenspaces: P_+ = (I+G9)/2,
          P_- = (I-G9)/2; the chirality-LOCKED structure means the J/PH pair
          (u_+, u_-) has |<u_+|G9|u_->| = 1 (S100b: the pair is gamma9-paired), so the
          spin projection is onto the rank-1 G9-eigenspace each member sits in;
      (4) compute the graded Berry sub-curvature on each G9-eigenspace branch:
          A^s_dir = i <u^s|d_dir|u^s> (single-state connection on the G9=s eigenstate,
          s=+/-) by the projector-identity evaluator (basis/phase-free; NOT the
          largest-component phase pin), then Omega^s = d_tau A^s_mu - d_mu A^s_tau over
          the (tau,mu) plaquette mesh; report max|Omega^+|, max|Omega^-|, and the
          cross-WZ graded component A^{WZ}_dir = i<u^+|d_dir|u^-> (S100b: gamma9 forces
          this imaginary-only, J reality kills the rest; median |A^WZ|=1.3e-17 expected).
    Pre-register the projector-identity evaluator Tr_band Q_ab = Tr[(d_aP)(1-P)(d_bP)]
    per S100b (the largest-|component| real-positive phase pin has pi-jumps and pollutes
    raw state-FD; rank-1 projectors per G9-member are immune). Map gap12 (the B1/B2
    crossing at the (0.10,+0.10) corner, von Neumann-Wigner) and report a
    defect-excluded companion.
  producing_script: "computations/_shared/s104_pauli_g9_subcurvature.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator
operator:
  type: "inequality"   # magnitude-floor test: does the graded sub-curvature vanish or survive?
  form: >
    Omega^s := d_tau A^s_mu - d_mu A^s_tau  (s in {+,-}, on the G9=s eigenspace) ;
    branch := PASS-STRENGTHEN  if max(max|Omega^+|, max|Omega^-|) < 1e-12
                                  AND median|A^WZ| < 1e-12 (cross-grade double-protection holds)
              FAIL-CRACK / INFO if max(max|Omega^+|, max|Omega^-|) > 1e-6 localized
              INFO              if intermediate (between 1e-12 and 1e-6) OR corner-defect dominates
              INFO-NOT-DISPATCHABLE  if the G9-graded eigenvector construction is numerically
                                  ill-posed on the J/PH pair (the applicability guard; S103 W4 honesty)

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "PASS-STRENGTHEN: max(max|Omega^+|, max|Omega^-|) < 1e-12 AND median|A^WZ| < 1e-12 ; CRACK: max|Omega^s| > 1e-6 localized"
  direction: "<"    # the PASS (strengthen) direction is the sub-curvature BELOW the trivial floor

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically
boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: >
    The S25/W5 theorem (Kosmann K_a anti-Hermitian => real eigenstates => Omega=0
    identically) is proven for the FULL D_K eigenbasis. The substitution chain below shows
    J^2=+1 reality is basis-independent and a gamma9-eigenspace PROJECTION of a real
    connection stays real on each rank-1 G9-branch (A^s real => Omega^s = dA^s of a real
    1-form = 0) UNLESS the projection mixes the chirality-locked pair in a phase-nontrivial
    way -- which S100b shows is double-protected (gamma9 imaginary-only + J reality). The
    1e-12 floor is the machine-epsilon expression of "exactly zero." Wei 2409.19551 (PDF:
    downloads/research-sweep-s103/geometric-phases-quantum-geometry/) supplies the
    Pauli-QGT definition whose imaginary part (Pauli Berry curvature) the CRACK branch
    would detect -- nonzero only in PT-symmetric systems where the projection breaks reality.

# (4) reachable_rationals
reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: false   # this is a magnitude-vanishing test (continuous |Omega^s| against a floor), NOT an integer-quantized invariant
  mesh_density: "continuous (max over 2500 plaquettes of a continuous curvature magnitude)"

# (5) machinery_pin_map
machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "2500"            # 50x50 plaquettes, identical to S96 / §W2-1
  L_max: "10"
  scan_range: "tau in [0.10, 0.30] ; mu in [-0.10, 0.10]"   # identical surface; fold enclosed at mu=0
  step_size: "Delta_tau = Delta_mu = 0.004"
  tolerance: "1e-12 (PASS-STRENGTHEN max|Omega^s| floor) ; 1e-6 (CRACK localized-curvature threshold) ; 1e-14 (sign-margin / trapezoid-cancellation relative floor per epistemic-discipline.md Class 8.3 item 4 + S100b item 7) ; 1e-7 (deg_tol for J/PH-pair identification, reused from S96 band_degeneracy)"
  scheme: "BP-4-gamma9-graded"     # BP-4 continuum Berry curvature, restricted to the gamma9=+/-1 chirality eigenspaces (Pauli-QGT-style spin projection)
  convention: "ABSOLUTE"
  random_seed: "N/A -- deterministic"   # eigh deterministic; signed-ascending column order (S100b cols 7,8) for deterministic J/PH-pair tracking (eigh argsort flips randomly on the |lambda|-degenerate tie -- MUST use signed order, not |lambda|-argsort)
  GPU_path: "cpu-cap-OMP8"         # (0,0) singlet 16x16; numpy eigh on CPU, OMP_NUM_THREADS=8; GPU optional (dim<100)
  # CONDITIONAL pins:
  regulator_pin: "N/A -- graded Berry sub-curvature is a property of the gamma9-graded D_K eigenbundle, not a Seeley-DeWitt a_n"
  CLASS: "FULL"   # exact eigendecomposition + exact gamma9 = Cl(8) product; NO SCHEMATIC helper
  publication_precision: "max|Omega^+|, max|Omega^-|, median|A^WZ| each to 3 sig figs; downstream rel_tol >= 1e-3"

# (6) audit_discriminators
audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

# (7) substitution_chain
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "A gamma9-graded projection of the substrate's real (BDI) Berry connection
            yields a graded sub-curvature Omega^s that is EITHER still identically zero
            (wall strengthens) or nonzero on a chirality branch (wall cracks); the prior
            is STRENGTHEN because J^2=+1 reality is basis-independent and the chirality
            pair is doubly protected."
      Def 1: G9 = gamma9 (x) I_dim, gamma9 = gamma_1...gamma_8 (Cl(8) chirality, (16,16)
             Hermitian involution; gamma9^2=I, {gamma9,gamma_a}=0). [build_chirality, verified]
      Def 2: P_s = (I + s G9)/2, s in {+,-}: orthogonal projector onto the G9=s eigenspace.
      Def 3: A^s_dir = i <u^s| d_dir |u^s>: the Berry connection of the G9=s-projected
             lowest-band state u^s (dir in {tau,mu}); Omega^s = d_tau A^s_mu - d_mu A^s_tau.
      Substitute: by S25/W5, the FULL-eigenbasis eigenstates of D_K are REAL (Kosmann K_a
             anti-Hermitian). A real state |u> has A_dir = i<u|d_dir|u> = i * (real number)
             = purely imaginary, and for a NORMALIZED real state <u|d_dir|u> = (1/2)d_dir<u|u>
             = 0 -> A_dir = 0 -> Omega = 0 (the S25/W5 result).
      Simplify: the question is whether PROJECTING onto G9=s breaks this. P_s |u> is a
             linear combination within the chirality-locked pair (u_+, u_-). S100b proved
             |<u_+|G9|u_->| = 1 (the J/PH pair is exactly the gamma9-paired pair) AND the
             cross-grade connection A^{WZ}_dir = i<u_+|d_dir|u_-> is gamma9-forced
             IMAGINARY-ONLY with J reality killing the remainder (median |A^WZ|=1.3e-17,
             99.96% of nodes < 1e-12). A purely-imaginary cross term with vanishing real
             part contributes NO curvature to either rank-1 G9-branch.
      Canonical form: Omega^s = dA^s where A^s is the connection of a state that remains
             real-gauge-equivalent on its rank-1 G9-eigenspace => A^s real => Omega^s = 0.
      Direction: max|Omega^s| -> 0 (below the 1e-12 floor) is the STRENGTHEN direction;
             max|Omega^s| > 1e-6 would CRACK (a phase that survives the projection).
      Conclusion: "The prior is PASS-STRENGTHEN: the gamma9-graded sub-curvature inherits
             the reality that kills the full Omega, double-protected by the chirality lock.
             But this is what the gate CERTIFIES rather than asserts -- the projection is
             onto a DIFFERENT connection (a different rank-1 bundle), and Wei's Pauli-QGT
             shows PT-class systems CAN carry a nonzero graded curvature where the ungraded
             one vanishes. A CRACK (max|Omega^s|>1e-6) would identify a previously
             unrecognized substrate geometric channel (a 'Pauli-Chern' sector)."

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: >
  PASS-STRENGTHEN (max(max|Omega^+|, max|Omega^-|) < 1e-12 AND median|A^WZ| < 1e-12):
  the BDI Omega=0 wall STRENGTHENS from "ordinary Berry curvature vanishes" to "ALL

  stronger and more falsifiable; the metric-without-curvature reading is hardened at the
  spin-resolved level. Bundles with §W2-1 PASS-TRIVIAL to give the strongest joint
  metric-without-curvature wall (Chern=0, Euler=0, graded-Omega=0).
FAIL_meaning: >
  Reserved for genuine numerical breakage (script crash, eigendecomposition failure,
  SHA mismatch) -- NOT for a nonzero sub-curvature. A nonzero graded curvature is the
  CRACK outcome, routed to INFO (a structured pre-registered result, not a failure).
INFO_meaning: >

  (a) CRACK: max|Omega^s| > 1e-6 localized -> a previously-unrecognized substrate geometric
      channel (a 'Pauli-Chern' sector); opens a follow-on amplitude gate for S105 and a
      §VII candidate; maps onto Wei's Pauli-QGT imaginary part.
  (b) INTERMEDIATE: max|Omega^s| between 1e-12 and 1e-6, OR a single corner-crossing
      plaquette (the S100b B1/B2 von Neumann-Wigner defect) dominates -> diagnostic; the
      defect-excluded companion + gap12 map are reported.
  (c) NOT-DISPATCHABLE: the gamma9-graded eigenvector construction is numerically ill-posed
      on the J/PH-degenerate pair (the applicability guard) -> the corridor is documented
      closed at the construction level per the S103 W4 honesty discipline
      (mechanical-closure-discipline.md). At plan-freeze the guard is POSITIVE (build_chirality
      is named and verified); (c) fires only on a runtime ill-posedness.

  files_created:

    - "computations/session-104/s104_pauli_g9_subcurvature.npz"

  estimated_time: "0.5-1 gate (~2-3 h): BUNDLED with §W2-1 (same lowest_band_multiplet eigenvector path); the delta over §W2-1 is the gamma9 = Cl(8) projection (build_chirality, kron with I_dim) + the per-G9-branch projector-identity curvature. Cheaper than a standalone gate because the eigendecomposition is shared."

  GEOMETRIC. The arrow is never inverted: D_K eigenbundle -> gamma9 (Cl(8) chirality)
  grading of the spin factor -> chirality-projected lowest-band state u^s -> graded Berry
  connection A^s -> graded sub-curvature Omega^s. A geometric phase IS eigenbasis-transport

  CRACK: a chirality sector carries a transport phase the full-spectrum reality hid -- a

## Wave 2 → Wave 3 Decision Point

Wave 3 (Krylov-complexity-peak + log-periodic IMS, owner gen-physicist) does NOT consume Wave 2 outputs — the two waves are structurally independent (geometric-invariant axis vs spectral-statistics/complex-dimension axis). No cross-wave gating.

**Within-wave routing (Wave 2 internal):**

- §W2-1 and §W2-2 share the eigenvector path but have INDEPENDENT verdicts (no AND-collapse). They are dispatched together (bundled) for compute efficiency, not adjudicated jointly.
- **Joint registry consequence (informational, not a gate):** if §W2-1 = PASS-TRIVIAL AND §W2-2 = PASS-STRENGTHEN, the metric-without-curvature wall reaches its strongest joint form (Chern=0 ∧ Euler=0 ∧ all γ9-graded Ω=0) — the g≈982.5 Provost-Vallée quantum-metric reservoir is the SOLE topologically-active object, and the agent-memory L0–L7 triviality chain gains its 12th independent zero invariant (Euler) plus a spin-resolved strengthening. This joint reading is recorded in the WP §"Wave 2 Synthesis"; it is NOT a separate verdict line.
- **If §W2-1 = PASS-NONTRIVIAL (Euler ≠ 0):** the substrate's first nonzero topological invariant. A §VII candidate (Euler-class bridge to atlas-08 Q14) is the carry-forward to S105; the §W2-2 verdict then localizes whether the nonzero invariant is chirality-graded. This INVERTS the joint reading above and is the high-information branch — flag prominently in the WP.
- **If §W2-2 = CRACK (max|Ω^s| > 1e-6):** a follow-on amplitude gate (the magnitude + sector of the Pauli-Chern channel) is the carry-forward to S105; pairs with the §W2-1 verdict to determine whether the cracked channel coincides with a nonzero Euler class.

| Gate | N_eval | L_max | scan_range | step | tolerance (PASS / floor / numerics) | scheme | convention | seed | GPU_path | regulator | CLASS |
|:-----|:-------|:------|:-----------|:-----|:------------------------------------|:-------|:-----------|:-----|:---------|:----------|:------|
| S104-EULER-CLASS-J-DOUBLET | 2500 | 10 | τ∈[0.10,0.30], μ∈[-0.10,0.10] | Δτ=Δμ=0.004 | 1e-3 (integer-quant) / 1e-12 (trivial F^Euler) / 1e-6 (nontrivial) / 1e-14 (Pfaffian numerics) | FHS-Pfaffian-Euler | ABSOLUTE | N/A-deterministic | cpu-cap-OMP8 | N/A (eigenbundle, not a_n) | FULL |
| S104-PAULI-G9-SUBCURVATURE | 2500 | 10 | τ∈[0.10,0.30], μ∈[-0.10,0.10] | Δτ=Δμ=0.004 | 1e-12 (strengthen Ω^s) / 1e-6 (crack) / 1e-14 (sign-margin) / 1e-7 (deg_tol) | BP-4-γ9-graded | ABSOLUTE | N/A-deterministic | cpu-cap-OMP8 | N/A (eigenbundle, not a_n) | FULL |

**PRDR notes (both gates):**
- **No `random_seed` freedom**: `eigh` is deterministic; both gates use deterministic gauge fixes (real Gram-Schmidt for §W2-1; signed-ascending column order per S100b cols 7,8 for §W2-2). The S100b lesson is binding: `eigh`'s `|λ|`-argsort flips randomly on the J/PH-degenerate tie — neither gate may sort by `|λ|`; both track by signed-ascending order.
- **No `regulator_pin` applies**: neither gate cites a Seeley-DeWitt `a_n` (Berry/Euler curvature is a property of the D_K eigenbundle, not a regulator-dependent spectral moment) — identical rationale to the S96 Chern companion row.
- **`CLASS=FULL` (both)**: exact eigendecomposition of the real Dirac matrix + exact Cl(8) γ-matrices; NO SCHEMATIC helper is consumed. No `convention=...-SCHEMATIC` suffix, no `# tier_pin=TIER-2` row.
- **GPU optional**: the (0,0) singlet is 16×16; the reused `eigh_H` only triggers the `torch.linalg.eigh` GPU path at dim≥100. Both gates pin `cpu-cap-OMP8` (numpy `eigh` + `OMP_NUM_THREADS=8` set before `import numpy`). §W2-1's Pfaffian uses `scipy.linalg.schur` (real Schur; `Pf²=det` verified to 1.78e-14). For the robustness sector-sweep arm (p+q≤2) the larger sectors may use the GPU path; that is a within-script `dim≥100` auto-switch in the reused `eigh_H`, NOT a separate pin.
- **`publication_precision`**: §W2-1 publishes `e2` to integer + residuals to 3 sig figs (`R_ideal` INFO companion to 4 sig figs); §W2-2 publishes `max|Ω^±|`, `median|A^WZ|` to 3 sig figs. Any downstream verifier sets `rel_tol ≥ 1e-3`.
